title: Reading memory: the brief at a session's start, recall, cited items, memory off in evaluations
request: The owner: continue the memory plan non-stop; 35.4 is how agents read memory.
spec: MEMORY_PLAN.md 35.4: brief(scope) into the first user message, never the system prompt; recall registered once; shown and cited ids recorded; evaluations with memory off.
plan: Build the brief and recall on 35.1's select and resolve.
Wire the intern's first message and register recall.
Turn memory off in every evaluation runner.
Review, fix, rerun the prompt and harness suites, record, commit.

decisions.decision: With memory off, stored items are not read but the case's own project notes still are
decisions.why: the rule is to start an evaluation with an empty memory; a project's notes are its own state, which the product shows

decisions.decision: The brief's header is a prompt file
decisions.why: a change to what an agent is told is a prompt change, gated by the suites like every prompt
a write in the project scope must be a move of the workflow graph, which this package does not add

change: dclab_rnd/memory/reading.py, tools.py (recall), readers.py (only the notes that still hold); agents/__init__.py; intern/loop.py; prompts intern_memory.md and memory_brief.md; memory_off_for_evaluation in every agent_eval runner and the Makefile targets; tests.

findings.defect: A cleared approval reached the intern as settled
findings.scenario: approve a stage, then a change clears it: the old reader dropped it, the new one showed it under 'do not ask again what is settled'
findings.cause: the new reader dropped only removed notes
findings.fix: only the notes the studio's own active() still holds are read
findings.impact: the intern would skip a stage it must run again

findings.defect: An existing test failed on the new prompt's wording
findings.scenario: test_project_memory looked for the old header
findings.fix: the test reads the new header

findings.defect: Memory off also hid the project's own notes
findings.scenario: a graded run with a saved solution no longer saw that note and redid the step
findings.cause: the brief returned empty before reading anything
findings.fix: memory off reads no store; read notes still count

findings.defect: Several evaluation runners still read memory
findings.scenario: the live suite, the programme journeys, benchmarks v3 and v4, the analyst, investigator, conversation and Home evaluations
findings.cause: the switch was added to three runners only
findings.fix: every runner's main turns memory off; a behaviour test plants a fact and checks nothing reads it after the switch

findings.defect: Lessons never reached the brief or recall, and a session without a project had no brief
findings.scenario: accepted workspace lessons shown on the memory page were never read by an agent
findings.cause: the intern read project notes only
findings.fix: accepted lessons read as know-how; the person's and workspace's items without a project too
findings.open: Home, the team and the orchestrator; remember through /mcp; protected names from callers; playbook bullets

findings.defect: Memory events could not be tied to their session
findings.scenario: memory.shown and memory.cited had no session or project id
findings.fix: the ids of the session and project ride on every memory read event

findings.defect: The brief's header was not under the prompt gate, corrections were not marked, and a secret in a note could reach the brief
findings.scenario: a header change would pass unmeasured; the model could not tell a person's correction; a pasted token in a note's reason reached the brief
findings.cause: a string in code; plain lines; read items skipped the secret screen
findings.fix: a prompt file; '(correction)' on a person's corrections; read items pass the secret screen

outcome: Agents read memory: the intern's first message holds the brief (the project's holding notes, accepted lessons, the person's and workspace's items, corrections marked), recall is a registered tool, and every evaluation runs with stored memory off. Seven review findings fixed; the brief for Home and the team and remember through /mcp are left open.
lessons: When a new reader replaces an old one, keep every filter the old one applied, or stale state returns.
Turn a switch on in every entry point, and test the behaviour, not the text.
risks: Other sessions edit the same evaluation runners.
